mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with temperatures at 74 degrees. Tonight, the moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase. If you stay up late, you might spot the International Space Station starting at 4:14 AM as it moves from the direction of Verona High School toward Madison, staying low on the horizon. The overnight low will be 67 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

September is set to be a month of advocacy in Verona. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to fight food insecurity and Suicide Prevention Month to raise awareness for mental health resources. Additionally, construction crews are flagging traffic on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday for utility work, so please plan for extra travel time.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon takes place at the high school, and the ice arena is hosting a Girls Try Hockey event.

In our weekly police report, on August 17, officers responded to the 500 block of Cross Country Road where a 21-year-old man was taken into custody following a request from the Department of Corrections.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
